title: docs(pm-dispatch): cloud lane CI-minute rules in orders and Go text
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8ChEr57nytUsP92HAidnH8Q)_

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#4749 (carries cloud#3779's rule too). Governed (Tier H): draft, merged by the maintainer by hand.

## 维护者速读

1. **问题**：cloud 的 CI 分钟里，「已绿又推送」15 天花了约 1,974 分钟，`ci:full` PR 全档平均比受影响档多约 9 分钟。
2. **改法**：pm-dispatch 的 cloud 车道说明加一条三项（三行）：一个引领句要求派发令与 Go 词带上三项推送纪律。
3. **三项**：ready 前容器跑类型检查与受影响测试，命令与结果入报告；ready 后修改一次推送，合 main 照 cloud `AGENTS.md` 第 7 条；`ci:full` 只给 pin 轮次与改 workflow 的 PR。
4. **行数**：把「范围」小节并入「形态」列表，文件仍是 28 行，棘轮天花板不动。
5. **配套**：cloud 仓 `AGENTS.md` 第 7 条同步收紧（另一个草稿 PR）。
6. **需要你做的**：审阅后手动合入。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md` only:

- The one-line `## 范围` section folds into the `## 形态` list (same text, prefixed `范围:`), freeing three lines.
- `## 常设承诺` gains one item over three lines (maintainer's order, 2026-11-16 14:50Z 「同意，全部 p1」): one lead clause tells seats to put all three into every card-thread order and Go text —
  - ① typecheck and affected tests in the container before `pr_ready`, command and result in the report;
  - ② after ready, fixes in one push; merging `main` follows cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7, which takes precedence over the generic merge-main discipline (no reason list restated here);
  - ③ `ci:full` only on pin rounds (`.objectstack-sha` changes) and PRs that change `.github/workflows/**`; everything else runs the affected tier.

Net line count 28 → 28, so the line ratchet's ceiling (28, headroom 0) is unchanged; no standing rule was cut.

## Why

The 2026-11-16 cloud CI cost analysis (items 6 and 7) measured the post-green re-push and `ci:full` minutes; the maintainer approved filing them as p1.

## Verification

Run in the container at head 98b349f3:
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → 0 (28 lines, ceiling 28; every line ≤ 120 bytes, the three new lines 118/119/115)
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` → 0 (no issue IDs in the skill text)
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` → 0
- `pnpm check:skill-links` → 0

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (n/a)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (n/a)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — this publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to generated docs.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's maintainer summary).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
